@graph.name: Three steps, and your distributor does the setup
@graph.description: Nothing to install on a computer. The app runs on the phone you already carry.

step.name: Ask your distributor
step.text: If they offer VoiceOrder Solutions, they open your account and load your guide. Not sure if they do? Ask us and we will find out.

step.name: Put the app on your phone
step.text: Sign in on your phone, and your guide is already waiting.

step.name: Speak, check, send
step.text: Say it, look at each line, then send. That is the whole routine.

@graph.name: Do I need a MarginEdge alternative for voice ordering?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. MarginEdge handles invoices and costs, and it has ordering of its own. Where a distributor of yours provides our app, order from them by voice and let MarginEdge take care of everything after the delivery.

@graph.name: Is VoiceOrder Solutions better than MarginEdge?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not at reading invoices, costing recipes, paying bills or closing your books: we do none of them. We do one narrower thing: a distributor order spoken aloud, from the guide that distributor keeps for you, and checked before it goes. If ordering is what sent you looking for a MarginEdge alternative, that narrower job, beside it, may be all you need.

@graph.name: Are VoiceOrder Solutions and MarginEdge linked?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Nothing links the two, no data moves between them, and neither company supports the other. Anything you say into our app travels to your distributor, not into MarginEdge.

@graph.name: Will this work with every supplier I buy from?

acceptedAnswer.text: Only with distributors who use VoiceOrder Solutions. MarginEdge can send orders to far more of your suppliers than we reach, so stay with it for the rest, and check with your other suppliers about our app.

@graph.name: Can the app still put the wrong item on my order?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, it can. Each line shows up for you to look over before anything is sent, so you can change it or take it out. That review is your safeguard, and a quick glance can still let an error slip past. Orders you phone or leave on voicemail get no order number from us; only orders sent in the app are numbered.

@graph.name: How do I get set up, and what does it cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Setup goes through your distributor: they add you and upload your guide, and most kitchens place a first order the same day. If yours does not offer it, or you are not sure, contact us and we will connect you with the right person. Cost is a question to put to your distributor, who gives you the app. We do not publish a price. MarginEdge, for its part, lists its price on its website.

@graph.name: Does that delivery still show up in MarginEdge's food cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, once its invoice is in. Send that invoice in as you do every other one, and the delivery is counted with the rest of your costs.

@graph.name: Where do the MarginEdge details on this page come from?

acceptedAnswer.text: Read off marginedge.com as it stood on 27 October 2026: their feature pages, price list and release notes. Their restaurant totals and time-saving claims are left off this page. If any of it has changed, the mistake is at our end.
